# 1 bed cottage for sale

> Delaney Estates are delighted to present No. 44 Brian Boru Avenue, a charming one-bedroom mid-terrace home situated in the heart of Clontarf, one of Dublin`s most sought-after residential locations. Rich in character and history, this delightful single-storey home forms part of a distinctive terrace of historic cottages originally built to accommodate Dublin`s tram workers.

## Fakta
- Typ: cottage
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 1 bed
- Plocha: 35 m²
- Energetická náročnost: G
- Lokalita: 44 Brian Boru Avenue, Clontarf
- Cena: 375 000 €
